user_goal: Publish the validated Plotkeeper UI, identity, connector, isolated-window, fallback-task, and reconstruction slice through a CodeRabbit-reviewed PR, merge only when green, then release and attest it.

authority.verbatim_text: Open a pull request for the validated Plotkeeper slice, require CodeRabbit and CI review before merge, update affected documentation and release notes, then merge, publish a release, and verify the result.

baseline.protection_evidence: origin/main fetched and exact public v0.1.6 baseline previously attested
baseline.selection_reason: The requested release publishes the seven validated commits currently ahead of the public baseline.

resources: GitHub deploy receipt variable and review secret name
owned local Plotkeeper installation and listener
semantic_changes: Publish only the already validated slice plus review-required corrections.
Update version, changelog, release notes, installation and usage documentation to v0.1.7 truth.
Open a PR without merging, resolve every actionable CodeRabbit/CI item, obtain independent phase receipts, merge non-interactively, tag/release, install, and attest exact live behavior.

No unrelated product feature, ledger history rewrite, user-project mutation, secret exposure, force push, merge before CodeRabbit/CI green, release before DEPLOY_READY PASS, or success claim without public/install/live attestation.

invariants: The exact seven-commit slice remains behaviorally intact unless a verified review finding requires correction.
All CodeRabbit comments and generated walkthroughs are read and reconciled with the diff.
PR remains open until review and CI are green and final docs/version changes are rechecked.
Every changed file is contract-authorized and frontend shared surfaces receive real browser verification.
Release tag, GitHub release, public main, installed package, and live listener resolve to the same candidate.
Rollback remains documented to the protected v0.1.6 baseline.
No secrets or personal/runtime data enter Git.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The exact candidate, cumulative scope, contracts, tests, and review evidence are independently validated before merge readiness.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Advancing an unvalidated candidate or omitting cumulative scope and contract-chain checks.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Exact Plotkeeper candidate and independent production reviewer

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: A PR to main contains the exact reviewed slice, CodeRabbit feedback is fully triaged/resolved, and required CI is green.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Merging early, ignoring walkthrough contradictions, or leaving actionable/nit feedback unresolved.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: GitHub PR, CodeRabbit, CI, and maintainer

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Final docs, changelog, version, rollback, tests, and release artifacts are internally consistent and independently approved for merge/release.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Stale docs/version/workflow pointer or unreviewed post-review delta.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Public main, v0.1.7 tag/release, Actions, installed package, connector, isolated pop-out, title/task/reconstruction UI, and rollback evidence match the approved candidate.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Artifact drift, failed live behavior, stale install, or unverifiable deployment receipt.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: GitHub public repository and installed local Plotkeeper user

proof_requirements.claim: Independent exact-candidate validation proves cumulative scope, contract chain, tests, and review evidence before release progression.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: production-goal-review cumulative diff, contract validation, full tests, and adversarial evidence
proof_requirements.expected_observation: VALIDATED PASS with exact candidate binding and zero open items

proof_requirements.claim: Raw PR metadata, every review thread/comment/walkthrough, and exact-SHA checks prove merge readiness.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: gh PR/check/review/comment inspection plus local exact suite
proof_requirements.expected_observation: zero unresolved actionable feedback and all required checks success

proof_requirements.claim: Independent review, full suite, browser QA, diff/scope, version/docs/changelog/rollback, and signed release verifier prove deploy readiness.
proof_requirements.required_environment: clean exact candidate checkout and live local pre-release service
proof_requirements.expected_observation: phase-matched PASS with zero open items

proof_requirements.claim: Public SHA/tag/release/Actions and installed/live behavior are exact and independently attested.
proof_requirements.required_environment: GitHub public repository and installed owned service
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: raw GitHub/API/Actions, package/source parity, health/UI/browser/process, rollback checks
proof_requirements.expected_observation: one exact candidate everywhere and all promised live paths green

release_requirements.required_receipt: open PR, CodeRabbit review, and exact-SHA CI success
signed VALIDATED to MERGE_READY to DEPLOY_READY bundle accepted by verifier and trusted guard
signed ATTESTED and CLOSED receipts after public/install/live proof

stop_conditions: Confidence at or below 95 percent, dirty or multi-worktree state, unexpected diff, unresolved CodeRabbit/CI finding, phase receipt non-PASS, GitHub SHA mismatch, install/live failure, secret/runtime-data exposure, or rollback failure.
known_discrepancies: Local main is seven commits ahead of origin/main and already includes user-authorized local installation; it is not yet public.

requirement_trace.authority: User-authorized CodeRabbit-reviewed PR, conditional merge, release, and check-in
